key_catalyst: U.S.-Iran Military Escalation and Strait of Hormuz Closure
reasoning: The sudden escalation of a direct military conflict between the U.S. and Iran, including the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, is a novel and critical geopolitical shock that has triggered a severe risk-off environment. This has simultaneously spiked oil prices and inflation expectations, pressuring interest rates and long-duration tech assets, leaving multiple high-severity catalysts unresolved ahead of the open.
